scripts.test: npm run test:parallel && npm run test:terminal-child
scripts.audit:security: npm run audit:root && npm run audit:web
scripts.audit:security:all: npm audit --audit-level=moderate && cd web && npm audit --audit-level=moderate
scripts.deps:review: npm run audit:security:all; audit_status=$?; npm run deps:freshness; freshness_status=$?; if [ "$freshness_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$freshness_status"; fi; if [ "$audit_status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "audit:security:all reported advisory moderate/dev findings; required production gate is npm run audit:security"; fi
scripts.web:test:control-room: npm run web:test:dashboardview && npm run web:test:cardsview && npm run web:test:agentsview && npm run web:test:filesview && npm run web:test:debugview
scripts.web:test:debugview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/debug-view
scripts.web:test:cardsview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/cards-view
scripts.web:test:agentsview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/agents-view
scripts.web:test:dashboardview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/dashboard-view
scripts.web:test:filesview: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/files-view
scripts.web:test:stores: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/runtime-store.test.ts src/__tests__/sync-client.test.ts src/__tests__/card-store.test.ts src/__tests__/stores/agents-conversation.test.ts src/__tests__/files-store.test.ts src/__tests__/mcp-store.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:runtime: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/runtime-store.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:sync: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/sync-client.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:cards: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/card-store.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:files: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/files-store.test.ts
scripts.web:test:store:mcp: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/mcp-store.test.ts
scripts.preflight: npm run web:test && npm run docs:verify
scripts.lint: npm run check:export-consumers && npm run check:stamp-producers && eslint src/ && node scripts/check-import-boundaries.cjs && node scripts/check-web-component-boundaries.cjs
scripts.build: tsc && tsx scripts/copy-system-template-prompts.js && npm run docs:build && (cd web && npm run build) && npm run test:compiled-prompt-composition
scripts.web:test:operator-smoke: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/operator-dashboard-smoke.test.ts && cd .. && npx playwright test -c tests/playwright/smoke/playwright.config.ts tests/playwright/smoke/operator-direct-load-routes.spec.ts tests/playwright/smoke/cards-independent-scroll-selection.spec.ts tests/playwright/smoke/card-status-presentation.spec.ts tests/playwright/smoke/http-live-sync-lease.spec.ts tests/playwright/smoke/cards-bootstrap-request-order.spec.ts
scripts.web:test:card-history-panel: cd web && npx vitest run src/__tests__/card-history-panel.test.ts
scripts.validate:routine: npm run typecheck && npm run check:export-consumers && npm run check:canonical-persistence-drift && npm run docs:verify
scripts.validate:ui: npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run web:test:operator-smoke
scripts.validate:release: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run web:test:operator-smoke && npm run docs:verify
scripts.web:test:e2e:smoke: npm run web:test:e2e:preview-smoke && npm run web:test:e2e:browser-client-smoke
